name: Isambard AI Skills
description: AI agent skills for Isambard HPC systems

skills.name: Slurm
skills.description: Submit, monitor, and manage HPC jobs using the Slurm workload manager on Isambard systems. Includes guidance on resource allocation, job scripts, and safe polling intervals.

skills.name: Python
skills.description: Install and manage Python environments on Isambard using Conda (Miniforge), uv, or Cray Python. Covers virtual environments, building aarch64 packages from source, compiler flags, mpi4py, and finding arm64-compatible packages.

skills.name: Modules
skills.description: Use the modules system, Cray Programming Environments (PrgEnv-gnu, PrgEnv-cray), compiler wrappers (cc, CC, ftn), GNU and NVIDIA compilers, and profiling tools (gprof, Cray perftools, Nsight) on Isambard.

skills.name: Spack
skills.description: Install, configure, and use Spack to build HPC software on Isambard-AI and Isambard 3. Covers the buildit config repository, Spack environments, concretizing, installing, and targeting neoverse_v2 / aarch64.

skills.name: Containers
skills.description: Run containers on Isambard using Podman-HPC and Apptainer (formerly Singularity). Covers pulling, building, and migrating images, GPU access, single-node and multi-node MPI/NCCL workloads over Slingshot 11, and aarch64 image selection.

skills.name: MPI
skills.description: Use MPI on Isambard with Cray MPICH, OpenMPI, or conda-installed MPI. Covers PrgEnv loading, PMI types (cray_shasta, pmi2, pmix), srun --mpi flags, libfabric and Slingshot 11 performance, and why mpirun/mpiexec must not be used.

skills.name: NCCL
skills.description: Use NCCL for multi-node GPU communication on Isambard-AI over Slingshot 11. Covers the brics/nccl module, aws-ofi-nccl plugin, Slingshot environment variables, building NCCL from source, benchmarking with nccl-tests, and NCCL in Apptainer containers.

skills.name: GPUs and CUDA
skills.description: Use GPUs and CUDA on Isambard-AI (NVIDIA GH200, sm_90). Covers loading cudatoolkit/nvhpc modules, compiling with nvcc -arch=sm_90, and CUDA forward compatibility for newer CUDA versions via NGC containers, NVIDIA HPC SDK, or conda cuda-compat.

skills.name: Docs Navigation
skills.description: Locate the correct page on docs.isambard.ac.uk for any Isambard question and answer from the live page instead of memory. Includes a topic-to-URL map of the documentation site and a stdlib Python page fetcher.

skills.name: Service Status
skills.description: Check the live operational status of Isambard facilities (status overview, known issues, planned maintenance) and report recent platform changes (docs updates, isambard-sc GitHub activity and releases). Never answers status questions from memory.
